prerequisites: Node.js 20.10+. Isolated subprocesses require supported POSIX process groups and provisioned filesystem sandboxing (Bubblewrap on Linux or sandbox-exec on macOS). Windows execution fails closed.

capabilities.title: Configuration and cases
capabilities.summary: Compare task prompts or ordinary Workflow Runner YAML.
details: Run init --stdout to inspect a template without dispatching or writing configuration. Replace placeholders with approved candidate/evaluator harness profiles.
Harness kinds include yylo_pi, workflow_runner and project-approved command adapters. The harness resolves providers/models; Benchmark treats model selectors as opaque.
Keep private registry state outside every candidate repository. Candidate and judge credentials remain consumer-owned.
capabilities.boundary: Running a plan grants neither provider spending nor production authority.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Immutable experiment plans
capabilities.summary: Bind cases, model selectors, attempts and evaluator configuration before execution.
details: Task prompts and workflow YAML normalize into v2 experiment and attempt plans. Planning performs zero dispatch.
Workflow bytes are hash-bound. With controlled-model-variable the comparison is model_only; otherwise it compares agent systems.
commands:
yylo-benchmark plan --task benchmark/task.md --models vendor/model --attempts 2 --output task-plan.json
yylo-benchmark run --plan task-plan.json --dry-run
capabilities.boundary: Do not use legacy task IDs, spend ceilings or authorization-grant examples with v2 planning.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Isolated attempts
capabilities.summary: Execute candidates in private fresh repositories, not shared task worktrees.
details: Every attempt has private home, temp, cache and configuration roots. Protected controller, registry, source and credential handles are removed from candidate environments.
Selective filesystem sandboxing denies protected roots; missing host support fails closed before dispatch. This is not a blanket container guarantee.
Post-execution manifests bind intentional edits, staging and commits. Later repository drift is rejected. POSIX timeout cleanup includes descendants and must be confirmed before terminal publication.
capabilities.boundary: A dry-run performs no dispatch; live run may contact paid providers and requires separate approval.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Evaluation and re-evaluation
capabilities.summary: Keep candidate truth separate from evaluator validity.
details: Deterministic checks and LLM judges retain prompt, rubric, profile, output and provenance. Judges can be blinded or identity-visible as configured.
Regrade/rejudge use retained evidence without rerunning the candidate. New generations append; old records remain immutable.
Required deterministic correctness or safety failures cannot be overturned by judge prose. Malformed outputs and infrastructure failures leave quality unknown.
commands:
yylo-benchmark regrade --plan task-plan.json --profile checks-v2
yylo-benchmark rejudge --plan task-plan.json --profile judge-v2
capabilities.boundary: Rejudging can incur judge-provider costs even though candidate dispatch is zero.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Recovery and verification
capabilities.summary: Reconcile exact retained evidence before considering another execution.
details: Recover, doctor, report and re-evaluation verify plan, workspace, post-execution manifest, terminal, evidence and evaluation linkage.
An attempt without terminal state is ambiguous and remains manual; it is not blindly dispatched again. Doctor/report refuse incomplete experiments.
commands:
yylo-benchmark recover --plan task-plan.json
yylo-benchmark doctor --plan task-plan.json
capabilities.boundary: Retained evidence cannot be edited to manufacture successful recovery.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Reports, runtime and cost
capabilities.summary: Report only what retained evidence establishes.
details: Reports retain requested/resolved/observed identities, evaluation generations, validity and evidence IDs behind aggregates.
Runtime is measured wall time in milliseconds. Candidate and evaluator time/cost remain separate. Unavailable cost is unknown, never zero.
Do not pool incomparable experiments or interpret invalid infrastructure evaluations as model quality.
capabilities.boundary: Legacy v1 artifacts remain historical evidence, not current v2 scoring oracles.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Governed production-touching workflows
capabilities.summary: Use a separate namespace and reviewed boundary for explicitly authorized production workflows.
details: The workflow namespace restores selected-step/model overlays, typed exclusive locks, envelopes and blinded per-step judging. It does not weaken isolated v2.
Plan binds workflow, policy, selected steps, variables, source and reviewed boundary identity. Planning and dry-run report zero dispatch.
Live execution needs the exact hash-pinned boundary and consumer authorization. Credentials remain in child memory, not plans/evidence.
Legacy config belongs to this separate lane; changing only its schema string is not a migration.
commands:
yylo-benchmark workflow migrate-config --help
yylo-benchmark workflow plan --help
yylo-benchmark workflow run --help
yylo-benchmark workflow recover --help
capabilities.boundary: No implicit production or spending grant; the governing policy and boundary must be reviewed separately.
